lessons.title: There is a problem

items.example: Det finns en säng i rummet.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a bed in the room.

items.example: Det finns ett problem med vattnet.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with the water.

lessons.tip: Use 'det finns' to talk about something that exists. It can refer to both singular and plural nouns.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: There is a room available.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Good! Is there a bed?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ja, det finns en säng i rummet.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is a bed in the room.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Is there cleaning every day?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ja, det finns städning varje dag.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there is cleaning every day.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Det finns ett problem med vattnet.
dialogue.meaning: There is a problem with the water.

scenario.partnerRole: You are the hotel receptionist. Respond to the learner's questions.
scenario.learnerRole: You are checking in to the hotel and asking about the room.
scenario.brief: Fråga om rummet och städning. Nämn ett problem.
scenario.goal: You need to ask about the room and report a problem.

lessons.title: Polite Requests

items.example: Kan jag få ett rum med havsutsikt, om möjligt?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I have a room with a sea view, if possible?

items.example: Kan jag få en extra handduk?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I have an extra towel?

items.example: Kan jag få hjälp med väskorna?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I get help with the bags?

items.example: Kan jag få en karta, snälla?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I have a map, please?

lessons.tip: When making polite requests, use 'kan jag få' followed by what you want. Adding 'snälla' makes it even more polite.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Can I have the key?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, here is the key.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kan jag få en extra handduk?
dialogue.meaning: Can I have an extra towel?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, jag ger dig en extra handduk.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I will give you an extra towel.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kan jag få hjälp med väskorna?
dialogue.meaning: Can I get help with the bags?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Of course! I will help you.

scenario.partnerRole: You are the hotel receptionist. Respond to the learner's polite requests.
scenario.learnerRole: You are asking for things you need.
scenario.brief: Be polite and ask for the key, a towel, and help with your bags.
scenario.goal: You need to make polite requests.

lessons.title: Reporting a Problem

items.example: Det är ingen vatten i duschen.
items.exampleMeaning: There is no water in the shower.

items.example: Kan du hjälpa mig med problemet?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you help me with the problem?

lessons.tip: When reporting a problem, use 'jag har ett klagomål' to express your issue. Be clear about what the problem is.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I have a complaint.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: What is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: The elevator does not work.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kan du hjälpa mig med problemet?
dialogue.meaning: Can you help me with the problem?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Det är ingen vatten i duschen.
dialogue.meaning: There is no water in the shower.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: We will fix it quickly.

scenario.partnerRole: You are the hotel receptionist. Listen to the learner's complaint and respond.
scenario.learnerRole: You are reporting a problem with the room.
scenario.brief: Explain the problem with the elevator and water.
scenario.goal: You need to report a problem.

lessons.title: Asking for Help

items.exampleMeaning: Can you show me the way?

items.example: Kan jag få en annan nyckel?

items.exampleMeaning: I need to call a friend.
Please help me with the key.

lessons.tip: When you need help, use 'kan du visa mig' to ask someone to show you something. Always be polite.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Can you show me the way?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I can show you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I need to get help.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: What should I do?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Please help me with the key.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Of course, I will help you.

scenario.partnerRole: You are the hotel receptionist. Help the learner with their requests.
scenario.learnerRole: You are asking for directions and help.
scenario.brief: Ask for directions and assistance with the key.
scenario.goal: You need to ask for help.
